name: llmc_matmul_forward
goal: Port matmul_forward_harness.cu (llm.c dev/cuda/matmul_forward.cu, fp32 build) to idiomatic SYCL 2020 with zero dpct helpers. Keep every kernel variant k in [1, 2, 3, 4] as its own SYCL kernel, computed on the SYCL device, and keep the program's contract: `build/candidate <input> <output> B T C OC` reads the inputs and writes each variant's outputs in order as raw float32, exactly as the CUDA main does. A hidden reference checks the output (atol 0.1 + rtol FLT_EPSILON*|ref|, llm.c's own fp32 rule). Success requires compile, verify and a zero-helper scan_helpers of the whole work directory (path '.') on the same sources: migrate's output under migrated/ counts, so delete it (delete_file) once your own port is done. migrate's output can be long: read it in parts (read_file offset/limit) or work from the CUDA harness. cuBLAS calls go to oneMath (oneapi::math::blas, #include <oneapi/math.hpp>; the compile flags already link -lonemath), not to oneapi::mkl product APIs.

museport.note: B=2,T=64 (llm.c B=32,T=1024); C=64 (llm.c 768); OC=256 (llm.c 3072, preserves OC=4*C). B*T=128 multiple of 128, OC multiple of 128, C multiple of 32 for kernel4 128x128 tiling and float4 accesses; sqrt_block_size 16 for all variants.
